draft.title: DRAFT: ICT risk-ticket triage and remediation follow-up
draft.objective: Provide a reviewable outline for triaging and communicating ICT risk tickets. Examples are from synthetic ticket IDs: ICT-001, ICT-002, ICT-003, ICT-004, ICT-005, ICT-006, ICT-007, ICT-008, ICT-009, ICT-010, ICT-011, ICT-012.
steps: Confirm ticket identity, asset, risk owner, severity, status and last update against the source record.
Document the stated business impact and existing control reference without changing the risk rating.
Identify active tickets and verify due dates against the reporting date.
Ask the named risk owner to confirm mitigation status and provide evidence of completed steps.
Escalate overdue or unresolved items using the organization's approved process.
Have an authorized reviewer approve any procedure before operational use.
draft.escalation_and_review: This example is not organizational policy. Seek approval from the relevant information security risk owner and confirm escalation pathways.
